channel.title: VoucherVault: Saving advice
channel.description: Practical money-saving advice from VoucherVault: why codes fail, how to find codes that work, student verification, sign-up discounts and big sale dates.

item.title: How to find voucher codes that actually work
item.description: Where working promo codes really come from: brand banners, official code pages, sign-up offers, group discounts and affiliate feeds, plus the traps to avoid.

item.title: Why voucher codes don't work, and how to fix it
item.description: Code rejected at checkout? The eight most common reasons voucher and promo codes fail, from minimum spends to region locks, and what to try next.

item.title: Singles' Day (11.11) explained
item.description: Singles' Day falls on 11 November. Where the 11.11 sale came from, which shops join in outside China, and how to shop it safely from the US, UK and Europe.

item.title: Student discount verification explained
item.description: UNiDAYS, Student Beans, SheerID, ID.me and ISIC: how student discount verification works, who can use it in the US, UK and Europe, and how to get the code.

item.title: Are email and app sign-up discounts worth it?
item.description: Welcome offers for emails, texts, apps and loyalty schemes often beat public codes. How they work, big-brand examples, and how to sign up without the spam.
